system.description:
At the height of the art the alchemist achieves the old dream, transmuting any element wholly into any other.

Transmute performs radical shifts in composition: any element may be transformed into any other, taking on the natural state and form of the new element. You must be aware of every element involved (at least two levels of Science or Science: Chemistry) and work in a controlled laboratory setting. The working takes one hour per level of Alchemy and concludes with a Static Mental Challenge set by the Storyteller. Retest with Science.
